bull.t: Recurring revenue dominance from installed base
bull.b: Intuitive’s razor‑and‑blades model yields high recurring revenue (85% of sales), driven by instruments, accessories and service per installed system. This creates predictable, high‑margin cash flow supporting reinvestment, R&D and durable earnings even if system placements fluctuate.

Near‑zero leverage and a growing equity base give Intuitive financial flexibility to fund R&D, support multi‑year product rollouts, and return capital via buybacks without stressing liquidity. Strong ROE progression signals improving capital efficiency and resilience through funding cycles.

bull.t: Robust free cash flow and cash conversion
bull.b: Sizable and improving free cash flow provides durable internal funding for product development, clinical studies and commercialization. High cash conversion cushions volatility in working capital and supports sustained investment and shareholder returns without relying on external financing.

bear.t: Visible deceleration in revenue and procedure growth
bear.b: Growth has moderated versus the high post‑2021 comps, reducing the automatic expansion of instrument/service volumes per installed base. Sustained slower procedure growth would constrain long‑run recurring revenue expansion and limit margin and earnings leverage over the medium term.

bear.t: China tender activity and pricing pressure
bear.b: Persistent tender weakness, local competition and regulatory pricing dynamics in China create a structural ceiling on system placements and I&A pricing in a major growth market. Delays in clearance for new platforms (da Vinci 5) exacerbate the region's longer‑term revenue uncertainty.

bear.t: Extended‑use instrument program introduces recurring revenue risk
bear.b: A move to extended‑use instruments could reduce per‑procedure instrument sales and recurring revenue over time. The unquantified magnitude creates structural forecasting risk for I&A revenue and complicates assessment of future margin sustainability and cash generation from installed systems.
